categories.main_business_segments: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Ltd. (CATL) primarily operates in the research, development, production, and sales of power battery systems, energy storage battery systems, and battery recycling products. Its business segments include power battery systems for electric vehicles, energy storage battery systems for power generation and grid applications, and battery materials and recycling. The company also invests in upstream battery mineral resources and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CATL utilizes advanced lithium-ion battery technologies including ternary lithium batteries, lithium iron phosphate batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and innovative chemistries like M3P and solid-state batteries. It employs digital and intelligent manufacturing methods, including digital twin simulation, 5G, 3D printing, and edge/cloud computing to enhance production efficiency and quality. The company also integrates Cell to Pack (CTP) and Cell to Chassis (CTC) technologies to optimize battery pack design and vehicle integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including global and domestic automotive manufacturers such as BMW, Daimler, Volkswagen, Ford, Hyundai, Honda, Volvo, SAIC, Geely, NIO, and others. Its products are used in passenger electric vehicles (BEV, PHEV, HEV), commercial vehicles, electric ships, drones, electric tools, and energy storage systems for power generation, transmission, and user-side applications. CATL also collaborates with energy companies and industrial clients for large-scale energy storage projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: CATL operates globally with significant market presence in China, Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. It has manufacturing and R&D facilities in multiple Chinese provinces and overseas production bases in Europe (Germany, Hungary), Southeast Asia (Indonesia), and North America. The company’s sales revenue is split between domestic (67%) and international markets (33%), with growing overseas shipments and strategic partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: CATL operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell manufacturing, module and pack assembly, and system integration. It also participates upstream by investing in and securing supply of key raw materials such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and phosphate through self-mining, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Additionally, CATL engages in battery recycling to close the supply chain loop.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing three core directions: electrification and energy storage to replace fossil fuels, and integration of electrification with intelligent technologies. It emphasizes four innovation systems: materials and material systems innovation, system structure innovation, green extreme manufacturing innovation, and business model innovation. R&D focuses on high energy density, fast charging, safety, long life, and cost reduction, with significant investment in digital and intelligent R&D platforms and collaboration with top universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: CATL generates revenue primarily through the sale of power battery systems, energy storage battery systems, and battery materials. It also earns income from battery recycling and related services. The company offers integrated energy solutions and commercial services such as battery swapping and smart energy management, contributing to diversified revenue streams. Investment income from equity holdings and financial assets also supplements its core business revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CATL is the global leader in the lithium-ion battery industry, holding the largest market share worldwide for power batteries (36.8%) and energy storage batteries (40%) as of 2023. It competes with other major battery manufacturers such as LG Energy Solution, Panasonic, BYD, and Samsung SDI. CATL’s competitive advantages stem from its technological leadership, extensive customer base, global supply chain integration, and scale of production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, CATL achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 400.9 billion, representing a 22% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 44.1 billion, up 43.6%. The company sold 390 GWh of lithium-ion batteries, with power battery sales at 321 GWh and energy storage batteries at 69 GWh, showing strong volume growth. CATL maintains robust cash flow generation and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, supporting sustained growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CATL emphasizes delivering high-performance, safe, and reliable battery products tailored to diverse customer needs, including fast charging, long lifespan, wide temperature adaptability, and high energy density. Its integrated solutions and advanced manufacturing capabilities enable cost-effective and scalable production. The company’s commitment to sustainability, including a zero-carbon strategy and circular economy through battery recycling, further differentiates it as a responsible and innovative leader in the global new energy sector.
